title: Verify: Drawer and modal store unit tests
summary: Unit tests for drawer and modal state.
description: Write tests/uiStore.test.ts cases for drawer and modal behavior using useUiStore.setState reset between tests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reset store, When toggleDrawer runs twice, Then drawerOpen is true then false
Given a reset store, When openModal then closeModal run, Then activeModal is 'contribution' then null

steps.action: Create the file; beforeEach resets via useUiStore.setState({ drawerOpen: false, activeModal: null }). Tests: defaults are false/null; toggleDrawer twice gives true then false; openModal('contribution') then closeModal() gives 'contribution' then null; setDrawerOpen(true) sets true.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/uiStore.test.ts
steps.expected: All drawer and modal tests pass
